title: Sindh Local Government Second Amendment Act 1991

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Second Amendment Act 1991
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 1992
ACT II OF 1992
SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act to amend the Sindh Local
Government Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 15th February, 1992]
No. PAS/Legis-B-12/91, dated
15-2-1992.--The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Bill, 1991 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 14th October, 1991 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 13th February, 1992 is hereby published
as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh;
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act maybe called the
Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from 1st January, 1991.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Second Amendment Act 1991
sections.description:
Amendment of section 45 of Sindh Ordinance No. XII of 1979

ACT II OF 1992
ACT II OF 1992
SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act to amend the Sindh Local
Government Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 15th February, 1992]
No. PAS/Legis-B-12/91, dated
15-2-1992.--The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Bill, 1991 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 14th October, 1991 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 13th February, 1992 is hereby published
as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh;
2. Amendment of section 45 of Sindh Ordinance No. XII of 1979.--In
the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979, in section 45, in subsection (4),
after the words "movable property", the words "or for leasing
out rights to collect taxes" shall be added.

sections.description:
Validation of contracts

ACT II OF 1992
ACT II OF 1992
SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act to amend the Sindh Local
Government Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 15th February, 1992]
No. PAS/Legis-B-12/91, dated
15-2-1992.--The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Bill, 1991 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 14th October, 1991 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 13th February, 1992 is hereby published
as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh;
3. Validation of contracts.--Any contract leasing out rights to
collect taxes entered into or executed by any council on or after 1st January,
1991 without inviting offers in auction shall, notwithstanding any rule,
instruction or directive to the contrary, be deemed to have been validly
entered into or executed.
